name: niri
readme_excerpt: A scrollable-tiling Wayland compositor. Getting Started | Configuration | Setup Showcase About Windows are arranged in columns on an infinite strip going to the right. Opening a new window never causes existing windows to resize. Every monitor has its own separate window strip. Windows can never "overflow" onto an adjacent monitor.
